Decides the facet the last round left open: a store implementing no
listFor is answered with an error frame (new ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED),
never an empty session_list. The ticket states it twice, and the repo
already states the principle at the store layer - listFor refuses on a
collection without find rather than reporting no conversations - while
the same store serves resume, so an empty list would deny conversations
it holds.

The acceptance test's expectation for this one case was corrected to
the error frame as part of the decision; a unit beside the handler pins
it too. Protocol spec (error table, semantics, section 5.9),
conversation-list spec, CHANGELOG and docs/session-stores.md all state
it, citations repointed by spec:names:fix.
